listing.name: Doctor Hauzer — pc-doctorhauzer (vs-sr-dev)
listing.summary: Experimental project. The project reports the opening, menu, attract mode, first room, camera, saving and music. A full campaign is not established, and hardware wait timing differs. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Japanese 3DO Doctor Hauzer disc pressed on 1994-04-15 and Portfolio20.21 files. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract your own disc with 3dokit and generate static code from launchme, sramtools, LMADM and FORMAT. Build pfboot with CMake. Portcove does not manage this download and has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

warnings: The project reports the opening, menu, attract mode, first room, camera, saving and music. A full campaign is not established, and hardware wait timing differs. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
